title: A LOST KEY.
summary: To the lady who found a little brass key upon the receiving-hall steps on Tuesday: its owner will gladly pay for its return. Pray do not try it in any door; it was made for a clock that has not yet been built. Apply to M. V., care of this office.
author: Agony Column Desk
